title: F6 skeptic: only R=17 (the lone non-trivial YAR shift)
hypothesis_summary: Skeptic-minimal counterpart to F6-61. Y=24 is congruent to -2 (a near-trivial shift) and A=0 is the identity; only R=17 is a non-trivial Caesar shift. This pack drops Y and A and tests Caesar shift=17 alone. Falsification check on F6-61: if F6-61 outperforms this floor, the additional shifts contributed; if not, F6-61 is over-reaching from a single-letter cue.

provenance_items.quote_or_summary: YAR superscript anomaly. R=17 as the only non-degenerate shift.

constraints: Single-layer Caesar with shift restricted to {17}.
caveats: Single-shift Caesar is historically eliminated for K4 under direct correspondence; this pack functions as a within-family floor.
